description: SIM100 v1 — CMSTG 1+1D time-domain galactic field evolution. First time-dependent CMSTG simulation at galactic scales. Tests: (a) does the field relax from uniform IC to the static Yukawa profile (SIM99)? (b) does attractive self-coupling (lambda<0) cause tachyonic condensation, and does the condensate give flat rotation curves? Spatial instability threshold: lambda_spatial_crit = -(k_min^2 + m0^2)/(3*psi_cosmo^2) ~ -778 (k_min = pi/r_max).

cmstg.lambda_crit_uniform_note: Uniform-mode threshold = -m0^2/(3*psi_cosmo^2) = -370. Spatial BC shifts it to ~-778.

galaxy.note: NGC 3198 — same as SIM99 for direct comparison. Same R(r) used.

scan.note: t_end=150 kpc/c ~ 489 kyr ~ 2.4 Compton periods. Sufficient to see condensation growth (gamma ~ 0.13 kpc^-1 for lambda=-1000 => e-fold time 7.7 kpc/c = 25 kyr). delta_max=100 included to check R-coupling contribution (expected negligible: 2*L0*|R_gal| ~ 1e-10 << m0^2=0.01).
